mapper.select: select dept_code, tpl_id, bound_by, bound_at from cght.t_dept_contract_template order by dept_code asc
mapper.insert: insert into cght.t_dept_contract_template (dept_code, tpl_id, bound_by, bound_at) values (#{dept_code}, #{tpl_id}, #{bound_by}, now()) on conflict (dept_code) do update set tpl_id = excluded.tpl_id, bound_by = excluded.bound_by, bound_at = now()
